issues.summary: Settings → General IdentitySection still uses its own 60-char limit instead of SPACE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH, so names of 31–60 chars can be saved there (and then fail the create/edit onboarding maxLength check).
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: IdentitySection.tsx:12 defines MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 60 and applies it at line 81; the PR never touches this file, so the gap is real. It is a pre-existing inconsistency outside the diff (the Linear issue targets the rename dialog), which caps it at low. The onboarding edit-mode fallout (CreateSpaceOnboarding validates maxLength on submit) follows from the same root cause.

issues.summary: The new constant's doc comment claims the limit is 'Enforced on both create and rename', but the Settings page rename path (IdentitySection) doesn't use it.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: constants.ts:14 was added by this PR, while IdentitySection.tsx:12/81 still enforces 60. The comment is misleading documentation, which is a minor issue.

issues.summary: The rename dialog enforces the limit only with the HTML maxLength attribute, so over-long input is silently truncated with no validation message, unlike create.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: UpdateSpaceForm.tsx:40 sets htmlInput.maxLength, and the Controller has no rules and renders no fieldState.error. The limit is still enforced, so the only cost is inconsistent UX feedback on paste.

issues.summary: An existing name longer than 30 chars isn't flagged in the rename dialog and can still be saved after a minor edit.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The claim that the name can be re-saved *unchanged* is wrong: the Save button is disabled when formName === space.name (UpdateSpaceForm.tsx:23-25). But maxLength only blocks growing the value, so deleting or changing a single character of a 40-char legacy name saves it with no error. That is a minor edge case.

issues.summary: The rename dialog doesn't apply the create form's special-character pattern validation.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: CreateSpaceOnboarding has pattern /^[a-zA-Z0-9 ]+$/, while UpdateSpaceForm's Controller (lines 32-43) has no rules, so rename accepts special characters. This inconsistency predates the PR and is outside its scope.

issues.summary: The tests don't cover the IdentitySection rename limit or the create-flow limit; only the dialog's maxlength attribute is tested.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The only new test is UpdateSpaceForm.test.tsx:82-87, and IdentitySection has no test file. The untested area is mostly code the PR didn't change, so the coverage gap is minor.

issues.summary: The claim is that NameInput is effectively unused (only SpaceCreationModal) and should be removed or aligned to the shared constant.
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: grep shows common/NameInput imported in many places (address book EntryDialog, AddOwner, SetNameStep, proposers, and others), so it is far from unused. It is a generic name input with its own 50-char contract, not a workspace-name field.

issues.summary: It's unclear whether the backend enforces the 30-char limit.
issues.label: unverifiable
issues.evidence: The generated CreateSpaceDto and UpdateSpaceDto (spaces.ts:468, 499) carry no maxLength, but generated types don't prove what the server validates. This can't be settled from this repo.
